notes.title: Under A New Sun - Current Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

after 10 days the community survey has wrapped up – thanks a lot to everyone who voted! Here are the results:

[list]
[*] [b]Tech update:[/b] 35.6%
[*] [b]Fauna update:[/b] 22.2%
[*] [b]Building update:[/b] 21.3%
[*] [b]Flora & cooking:[/b] 20.9%[/list]

With the tech update clearly taking the top spot, this will be the next big update. The other three categories ended up in a surprisingly close race, with the fauna update landing in second place. I've also read through all of your added comments and taken lots of notes for further additions or improvements.

Based on that, here’s a breakdown of what’s coming next for Under A New Sun:

[list]
[*] [b]Tech update:[/b] 3D printer for crafting electrical components and other gear (some new and some that could previously only be found), electrical lights, wind turbine

[*] [b]Fauna update:[/b] a livelier world with more animals and new drone variations

[*] [b]Building update:[/b] general improvements for the building system, new plank structures to build, more furniture and decorative elements

[*] [b]Flora & cooking:[/b] more plants to discover and grow, craftable antidote, poison arrows, additional food variety and cooking mechanics

[*] [b]Islands / map expansion:[/b] more islands in various sizes with new things to explore and more wrecks that can be entered

[*] [b]Story:[/b] ongoing additions of narrative elements, discoveries, and signs of the crew (this point may not be included in a single update but happen over time together with other updates)

[*] [b]Character customization:[/b] more options to customize your player character

[*] [b]Miscellaneous:[/b] various quality of live improvements, expansion of the Fandom wiki, more diving sites and equipment
[/list]

[i]Keep in mind that some points may change over time with further development and that the order listed here does not necessarily mean that the updates will take place in this exact order nor that there won't be more additions than currently listed. And as always, any suggestions and feedback is very welcome![/i]


Thanks for helping shape the future of Under A New Sun!
New Horizon Games

notes.title: Achievements, faster loading times, progression during sleep and more (v0.8.1)
notes.content:
Survivors,

A new update has arrived, bringing exciting improvements and features to Under A New Sun!

A total of 28 achievements have been added, offering new goals to pursue while playing.
The save and reload system has been reworked to allow much faster loading times – to benefit from this change, each existing save needs to be loaded by you once and saved again.
In addition, the world will now also progress further during sleep, which is depending on the total sleep time.

Life on the sailing ship has become more convenient as well: it is now possible to build an air tank refill station, a water generator or a fridge directly on the ship, powered by the already existing solar array that can be built on the ships deck.

For smoother gameplay, the watch is now visible while diving underwater, a crouch ability has been added (making it easier to reach certain spots or build with more precision), and the wire building system received multiple improvements, including a maximum building length that is now three times longer than before.

[list]
[*] Added achievements to the game (28 in total)
[*] Reworked some parts of the save and reload system to achieve much faster loading times (this will require you, to load every of your existing games and save it new)
[*] During sleep the game is now progressing further (depending on the total sleep time)
[*] Sleeping on a ship while sailing increases the traveled distance (not linear - for physics reasons it can only speed up to a certain amount)
[*] Air tank refill station can now be build on the sailing ship
[*] Water generator can now be build on the sailing ship
[*] Fridge can now be build on the sailing ship
[*] The players watch can now be seen underwater
[*] Added crouch ability (makes it easier to reach some locations or while building)
[*] Swapped the songs played by the space radio 9000 (to avoid copyright claims for lets players)
[*] Fixed items spawned directly on the ground sometimes glitching through the ground
[*] Increased durability for food items inside a fridge (+50%)
[*] Increased max length for building wires (now max. 24m instead of 8m)
[*] Building a wire will show up in blue until the max. length is exceeded or the attachment point is not available
[*] Adjusted behavior of wires during building
[*] Added a pop-up screen when trying to overwrite a save file that is not the one that was loaded
[*] Added info that bottles filled with dirty water can be used to water plants
[*] Increased drag speed for the sailing ship for easier handling
[*] Increased building distance from 4.5m to 5m
[*] Novillium ore now has a chance to respawn
[*] Some synthetic fibers items now respawn
[*] Added an indicator inside the fridges inventory, showing if the fridge is active or not
[*] Fixed recipe not available for players in co-op following the tutorial, where another player has finished the previous task alone
[*] Fixed the computer terminal for co-op games (can now be accessed by every player to achieve the security clearance)
[*] Fixed rendering bugs for the female player version
[*] Fixed players joining a co-op game while playing in singleplayer causing some of their items and buildings appear in the co-op game
[*] Fixed drowning sounds and visuals persist even if an air tank is inserted
[*] Fixed solar panel building on roofs
[*] Fixed solar panel array on the sailing ship calculating wrong energy amounts
[*] Fixed some problems where the sailing ship could start flying in the air
[*] Fixed lightning would appear always on the same spot for co-op players (now synchron with the host)

[/list]

Enjoy the adventure!

notes.title: New Dawn Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
Survivors,

This is it—the biggest update to [b]Under A New Sun[/b] so far: the [b]New Dawn[/b] update is finally live!

You can now dive into a completely reimagined world. If you haven’t already, make sure to check out the updated Steam page—it’s been fully overhauled to reflect everything that’s new, including a new trailer.

[b]New Dawn[/b] brings a massive list of changes, but most notably, the entire world has been reworked from the ground up to feel more like a truly alien environment. There’s now [b]official co-op support[/b], larger islands to explore, a new starting point on a brand-new island, new ores and tools, the chance to reclaim your lost security clearance, and the ability to access wreck sites and uncover more of the story. There's also plenty of fresh content to discover and build along the way.

One of the most important changes is a complete overhaul of the game’s progression system. Unlike earlier versions, you no longer start with everything unlocked. Now, crafting and building options are tied to discovery—you’ll need to explore, gather, and interact with the world to gradually unlock recipes. Some items become available just by picking up the right materials, others by discovering hidden structures or rare knowledge-based items scattered throughout the world.

This new system makes early gameplay far more engaging and gives you a real reason to explore and experiment. If you’ve played before, I do highly recommend to start a fresh run!

notes.title: Archery, Female Character & Gameplay update is now available! (v0.7.0)
notes.content:
Survivors,

a new major update is now available!

This update brings a complete overhaul to archery, introduces a playable female character, and rolls out a variety of Gameplay changes.

The archery update features reworked animations and models, along with the addition of the new powerful recurve bow, a stronger weapon at the iron tier level. And after forging some arrowheads, it is now also possible to craft yourself some iron arrows! But note, arrows will now need feathers to be crafted, which can be found throughout the world or harvested from seagulls.

You may as well now choose to play as either a male or female character. To make the story suitable for both, the protagonist's name has been updated to a unisex version, that is visible on the cryocapsule and the notes scattered across the world.

This update also brings various new mechanics to enrich Gameplay:
The first to name is the [b]comfortable status effect[/b] that increases your health regeneration. It can stack up to multiple levels, but is only active while being in a comfortable area.
The second new mechanic is [b]stamina[/b]. It depletes when using tools and weapons or running around. The amount that is needed for each task is also influenced by the new stamina skill.
And the third one is the [b]rested status effect[/b] that temporarily increases stamina, it can be obtained by sleeping while being comfortable and stacks up to the same level as the comfort status.
For more details, check out the full release notes below.

And to address the reoccurring concern about travel times between islands, all sailing vessels are now 30-40% faster, making your journeys smoother and quicker than ever.

notes.title: Under A New Sun - Current Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors!

As a lot of you are eager to know where Under A New Sun is heading, here is the current roadmap, featuring multiple additions, changes and updates that are either already in work or planned for the near future.

Keep in mind that some points may change over time with further development and that the order listed below does not necessarily mean that the updates will take place in this exact order nor that there won't be more additions than currently listed. And as always, any suggestions and feedback is very welcome!

[b]Roadmap:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked inventory:[/b] layout and graphics overhaul, stack movement, increased inventory space, weight system, more information of items and buildings [i](scheduled for March 1st)[/i]

[*] [b]Story:[/b] more things to explore, more elements that tell what happened on the Horizon 7, accessible wrecks, more special items to find, drone & robot variations, etc. (this point will not be included in a single update but happen over time together with other updates)

notes.title: 'Project New Horizon' becomes 'Under A New Sun'
notes.content:
After months of hard work, I'm proud to announce the first of a long series of updates to the community. I'm very excited to show you everything new and what I was working on.

First of all, as you may have noticed, the game was renamed from 'Project New Horizon' to 'Under A New Sun' to give it a more fitting title. The decision was tough and it took me some time to work everything out, but I'm glad I've done it!

The game received several major graphical improvements and various new models for old and new things. A new and huge handmade map with a lot more to discover, plenty of islands, underwater places and remainings of the crashed ship are waiting to be explored. The sky was reworked to fit better to the mood of the game, and a global wind system got introduced that will influence the weather and sailing abilities of your ships. But don't worry, you can now also adjust the sails of your vessel to the wind!
These are just a few of the recent updates and there are a lot more to come!

As some of you have been asking for a better possibility to communicate with the developer, there is now also a Discord server linked on the store page, free for everybody to join!

Please let me know if you got any feedback, critique or ideas for the future development!


Until the next update
